proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2757 kaphoṇi gives Hindi kohni/kehunī, Bengali kanui and Western Pahari khunni “elbow”. Simple contracted q/k and vowel variants preserve this historical elbow family. Reviewed comparison: Rana kohʌni “elbow” (f_to57unzeaeio2). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed. RNS uncertainty concerns locality attribution rather than lexical reading, as established by the source audit.
